metadata.description: Plugins for omp, Claude Code, Codex and the Tern terminal

plugins.name: piebird-kagi-search
plugins.description: Kagi web search for coding agents, with your own Kagi account

plugins.name: piebird-sessions
plugins.description: Read coding agents' session journals (omp, Claude Code, Codex): a session_read tool that reads, pages and searches a session by id and line, with asks shown in full, and the agent told its own session id

plugins.name: piebird-threads
plugins.description: Open threads in front of omp's agent: the project's open lines of work, in the folder its .omp/threads.json names, listed before a prompt whenever the list changes; a rule and skill on writing them

plugins.name: piebird-workflow-rules
plugins.description: How to work: weigh problems in proportion, think before building, fix corrections as classes, failure classes to check, project tooling, changelogs and when to ask
